name: buildmates
description: Use approved work context to meet builders, review introductions, and collaborate in shared rooms.

interface.longDescription: Buildmates turns user-approved summaries of current work into a builder profile, relevant introductions, and shared rooms. The current workflow keeps introductions reviewed and consent-based: users control what is shared, how matching works, and when to act.
defaultPrompt: Set up Buildmates and create my profile.
Find builders relevant to my current work.
Show my Buildmates connections and shared rooms.
